versions.changelog:
crypto-wallet-explainer 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Explains public wallet balances, transaction history, NFTs, and live token prices using attested dRPC and CoinGecko POST reads.
- Strictly read-only: never requests keys, signing, wallet connections, or initiates transactions.
- Privacy conscious; never persists or unnecessarily repeats public addresses.
- All data queries use documented POST operations with explicit user approval for any credentialed or paid action.
- Results are clear, flagging limitations or ambiguities, and never provide financial advice.
